title: V5: seal-slot suppression metrics + attester preflight (fix deadline poll inflation)
brief: Post deadline-scheduler soak: seal_suppression_summary shows ~97% suppression while sealed_in_window ~37/100s unchanged. Root cause: metrics count every 10ms poll past deadline as one tick+suppression (~100/s), not one logical seal slot per nominal interval (~1/s). Also proposer calls record_cluster_prop_tick + run_cluster_gate when no live attester is connected, spamming quorum_pending logs at startup. Fix: slot-based suppression accounting (one suppress per failed attest window per grid deadline), attester-transport preflight before propose/gate, longer idle sleep when quorum impossible, keep 10ms poll only inside an active attest slot.

symptoms.logs: burst of seal_suppressed_by_cluster / missing_round_state at proposer start until attester connects
symptoms.hypothesis_confirmed: poll_pause(10ms) IS present on gate-fail continue (lifecycle.rs) — not a zero-delay spin; counters are wrong

root_cause.metrics: is_proposer: supp_win.tick_inc() every loop iteration while now>=next_seal_time_ms; cluster_inc() on every run_cluster_gate false — ~100 ticks/sec vs ~1 seal/sec
root_cause.preflight: no check for live attester peers before record_cluster_prop_tick / run_cluster_gate
root_cause.logging: run_cluster_gate missing_round_state uses warn every poll when height>2; propose tick creates rounds before transport ready

A_slot_metrics.model: One seal_slot per grid deadline attempt (tracked by slot_deadline_ms = next_seal_time_ms while attempting this height)
rules: On first poll entering attempt for current slot: slot_attempt_inc (at most once per slot_deadline_ms)
While slot open: poll loop may run every SEAL_POLL_INTERVAL_MS but does NOT increment suppression counters
slot_suppressed_inc once when slot ends without Ok(seal): attest_timeout for round, OR next grid boundary passed without seal, OR height advanced without seal for that slot
Ok(seal): close slot without suppress; sealed_in unchanged
emit_suppress_summary: report slots= slot_attempts, suppressed= slot_suppressed, suppression_pct= suppressed/slots (expect ~30–70% on CY steady state, not ~97%)
A_slot_metrics.compat: Rename log fields ticks→slots (or dual-publish one release); update docs/runbooks/v5-cy-cluster-precloseout-soak.md

when_WaitingAttester: Do NOT call run_cluster_gate (no missing_round_state spam)
Do NOT increment slot suppression counters
sleep min(nominal_ms/4, 500ms) or const SEAL_WAIT_PEER_MS — not 10ms poll storm

D_logging.missing_round_state: only after preflight Ready (propose path active)
